USER: Hello, I need to transfer my prescriptions from CVS to your pharmacy.
ASSISTANT: Good morning! I'm Rachel from Walgreens pharmacy. I'll be happy to help you transfer your prescriptions. First, may I have your name?
USER: It's Matthew Harrison.
ASSISTANT: Thank you, Mr. Harrison. And your date of birth?
USER: September 5th, 1975.
ASSISTANT: Phone number?
USER: 773-555-4429.
ASSISTANT: Current address?
USER: 3924 North Lincoln Avenue, Chicago, Illinois, 60613.
ASSISTANT: Do you have prescription insurance?
USER: Yes, I have UnitedHealthcare.
ASSISTANT: Can I get your member ID number?
USER: It's UHC887234561.
ASSISTANT: And the group number?
USER: Group number is 445KL8.
ASSISTANT: Is the cardholder name Matthew Harrison?
USER: Yes, I'm the primary.
ASSISTANT: Perfect. Now, which CVS location are your prescriptions at?
USER: The one on Broadway, near Belmont. I think it's 3637 North Broadway.
ASSISTANT: Yes, I know that location. What prescriptions do you need transferred?
USER: I have four medications. Let me get my bottles... Okay, I have metoprolol for blood pressure.
ASSISTANT: What strength and how often do you take it?
USER: 50 milligrams twice daily.
ASSISTANT: And the prescription number from the CVS bottle?
USER: It's RX7739482.
ASSISTANT: Got it. What else?
USER: Rosuvastatin for cholesterol, 20 milligrams once at night.
ASSISTANT: Prescription number for that one?
USER: RX7739483.
ASSISTANT: And the third medication?
USER: Jardiance for diabetes, 10 milligrams once in the morning.
ASSISTANT: That's a newer diabetes medication. Prescription number?
USER: RX7739484.
ASSISTANT: And the fourth one?
USER: Gabapentin 300 milligrams, three times daily for nerve pain.
ASSISTANT: Prescription number?
USER: RX7739485.
ASSISTANT: Who is your prescribing physician?
USER: Dr. Amanda Foster at Northwestern Medical Group.
ASSISTANT: Do all four prescriptions have refills remaining?
USER: Yes, they all have at least 6 refills left.
ASSISTANT: Excellent. When did you last fill these?
USER: About a week ago, so I have three weeks of medication left.
ASSISTANT: Perfect timing. Do you have any drug allergies?
USER: I'm allergic to codeine - it makes me break out in hives.
ASSISTANT: Important to note. Any other medications, vitamins, or supplements?
USER: I take vitamin D3, 2000 units daily, and fish oil.
ASSISTANT: Good to know. Now let me check your insurance coverage for these medications...
USER: Will the copays be the same?
ASSISTANT: Let me see... Your metoprolol is a Tier 1 generic, $10 copay. Rosuvastatin is also Tier 1, another $10.
USER: That's what I was paying at CVS.
ASSISTANT: Good. The Jardiance is Tier 3, showing a $47 copay.
USER: Yes, that's right.
ASSISTANT: And gabapentin is Tier 1, so $10.
USER: So $77 total for all four?
ASSISTANT: Correct. Now, would you like us to synchronize these so they all refill on the same day?
USER: Oh, can you do that?
ASSISTANT: Yes! We'll do short fills on some to align them all to the same refill date. Makes it much easier.
USER: That would be great. Just one trip to the pharmacy.
ASSISTANT: Exactly. Would you like automatic refills?
USER: What does that mean?
ASSISTANT: We'll automatically start preparing your refills 5 days before you run out and text you when they're ready.
USER: Yes, that sounds convenient.
ASSISTANT: Perfect. Now, I'll contact CVS to transfer these. We'll need about 2-3 hours to process everything.
USER: So I can pick them up this afternoon?
ASSISTANT: We'll have them ready by 2 PM today. Is text the best way to notify you?
USER: Yes, text is perfect.
ASSISTANT: Great. Your Walgreens prescription account number will be WG-9847221.
USER: Should I write that down?
ASSISTANT: Yes, you'll need it for refills or any pharmacy questions. WG-9847221.
USER: Got it. Which Walgreens should I go to?
ASSISTANT: You can use any Walgreens, but I'm setting your home store as the one at 3419 North Broadway, just a few blocks from the CVS you were using.
USER: Oh that's convenient, even closer to me.
ASSISTANT: Yes, and we're open until 10 PM every day. We also have a drive-through.
USER: Perfect for bad weather days. Do you have an app?
ASSISTANT: Yes, the Walgreens app lets you manage prescriptions, order refills, and even see pill images to identify medications.
USER: I'll download that. Can I pay through the app?
ASSISTANT: You can pre-pay and just pick up at the counter or drive-through. Very quick.
USER: Great. Oh, does Dr. Foster need to approve the transfer?
ASSISTANT: No, we handle the transfer between pharmacies directly. But I see here she's already in our system, so future prescriptions from her will come straight to us.
USER: Good. What about vaccine records? I got my flu shot at CVS.
ASSISTANT: We can request your immunization history from CVS as well. Would you like us to?
USER: Yes, please. I never remember when I got what vaccine.
ASSISTANT: We'll add that to your profile. Speaking of vaccines, have you had your COVID booster this fall?
USER: Not yet, been meaning to.
ASSISTANT: We have appointments available. You could get it when you pick up your prescriptions if you have time.
USER: Maybe next time. I have meetings this afternoon.
ASSISTANT: No problem. Now, do you need any other pharmacy services? We do medication consultations, blood pressure checks, diabetes supplies.
USER: I do need to order test strips for my glucose meter.
ASSISTANT: What meter do you use?
USER: The OneTouch Verio.
ASSISTANT: Those test strips are covered by your insurance. $35 for a box of 100. Should I add those to today's order?
USER: Yes, please do that.
ASSISTANT: Added. So your total today will be $112 - the four medications plus test strips.
USER: Sounds right.
ASSISTANT: Perfect. Everything will be ready at 2 PM. You'll get a text when it's ready. Your account number is WG-9847221, and you're all set up for auto-refills with medication synchronization.
USER: This was easier than I expected. Thanks, Rachel!
ASSISTANT: You're very welcome, Mr. Harrison! We'll take great care of you here at Walgreens. See you this afternoon!
